# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are prioritized for the latest stable releases.

Support for older versions is evaluated individually.
Users should upgrade to the latest supported release
whenever possible.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not disclose security vulnerabilities in public
GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests.

For repositories with private vulnerability reporting
enabled:

1. Open the affected repository on GitHub.
2. Navigate to the Security tab.
3. Select "Report a vulnerability".
4. Provide a description, reproduction steps, and
   potential impact.

If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable,
request a private contact method from the maintainers
without including vulnerability details publicly.

## Disclosure Process

Maintainers will evaluate reported vulnerabilities and
coordinate fixes and public disclosure when appropriate.

Please avoid publicly disclosing technical details
before maintainers have had an opportunity to investigate
and address the issue.

## Sensitive Information

Never include credentials, tokens, private keys,
or other secrets in vulnerability reports.
